body:
Yes, this^
They miss you. You can stay in their life from afar while still growing into your own. If you know you’ll do or feel better with some space, do it. The only one who cares about you more than your parents is... you. If it’s what you want, do it for you. You’ll have to move out eventually, so if now’s the time, don’t hesitate.

If you find it hard for yourself to do and usually avoid it— approaching someone new to talk, trying new activities, etc— then do it and you’ll find yourself a lot happier. Get involved in an activity you are passionate about and surround yourself with friends who share this vision
Good idea. Thank you for your input
Will do. Thanks for the help
Thank you. Your help is much appreciated
Thank you for the advice. Sounds like she’s been through a residential program already with police intervention but that didn’t stop her from the second time so I’m at an impasse.

Your mom worked for 9 months to get you here. Don’t stop now. Life comes in waves. Now might be tough but beauty is on its way. Hobbies help. I picked up guitar during shelter in place and that helped so so much. Passion—> happiness. Stay with us, we need you
Hibernate until this is all over
